newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least 13 killed in Colombian plane crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 13 killed in Colombian plane crash.

text.p: A small commuter plane crashed on Saturday shortly after takeoff from Colombia's northwest city of Medellin, killing at least 13 people, authorities said.

Civil Aviation officials said the plane, a Twin Otter belonging to Colombia's Aces airline, had 13 passengers and two crew members aboard when it crashed into a mountain on the southwestern outskirts of Medellin about two or three minutes after takeoff from the city's Enrique Olaya Herrera airport.
At least 13 of the 15 people aboard the plane, which was destined for Bahia Solano in the northwest province of Choco, were killed on impact, airport officials said.
There was no immediate word on the cause of the crash or on the identities of the victims aboard the ill-fated Canadian-built aircraft.
Olaya Herrera has long been described by pilots as one of the more dangerous airports in Colombia. It is nestled into a relatively narrow valley surrounded by steep mountains.
